lessons.title: The Open Chord Foundation
lessons.description: Learn to play the G major and C major open chords without buzzing strings.

steps.title: Understanding chord anatomy
steps.description: What makes up a chord and how fingers sit behind the fret.

steps.title: G major
steps.description: Middle finger 3rd fret low E, index 2nd fret A, ring 3rd fret high e.

steps.title: C major
steps.description: Ring 3rd fret A, middle 2nd fret D, index 1st fret B. Skip the low E.

steps.title: Clean check
steps.description: Pluck each string one at a time and fix any buzz.

lessons.title: Basic Guitar Chords
lessons.description: Learn the fundamental open chords: C, G, D, Em, Am.

steps.title: Chord shapes
steps.description: Learn finger placement for C, G, D, Em, Am.

steps.title: Clean fretting
steps.description: Avoid muted strings with correct pressure.

steps.title: Strum practice
steps.description: Downstrums at 70 BPM with a metronome.

steps.title: Chord changes
steps.description: Switch between C → G → D smoothly.

steps.title: Mini challenge
steps.description: Play a 2-minute progression without stopping.

lessons.title: Strumming Patterns
lessons.description: Master the essential strumming patterns behind most popular songs.

steps.title: Down/up basics
steps.description: Alternate down and up strokes at 80 BPM.

steps.title: Pattern 1
steps.description: D D U U D U for 4 minutes.

steps.title: Pattern 2
steps.description: D DU UDU with the accent on beat 2.

steps.title: Muted strums
steps.description: Add muted strokes for rhythm control.

steps.title: Tempo build
steps.description: Increase speed from 70 to 90 BPM.

lessons.title: Smooth Chord Transitions
lessons.description: Improve your chord switching speed and accuracy.

steps.title: Anchor fingers
steps.description: Keep the ring finger planted between G and C.

steps.title: Two-chord drill
steps.description: Switch G ↔ Em for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Three-chord drill
steps.description: Cycle C → G → D at 80 BPM.

steps.title: Clean transitions
steps.description: Lift fingers just enough to remove buzzing.

steps.title: Challenge
steps.description: Play the 4 chords for 4 minutes at 90 BPM.

lessons.title: Bollywood Strumming: The 8-Beat Flow
lessons.description: Master the muted-slap strumming used in songs like Kabira and Ilahi.

steps.title: Downstroke with the thumb
steps.description: Relaxed wrist, strike all six strings.

steps.title: Palm mute (X)
steps.description: Land the side of the palm on the strings for a percussive slap.

steps.title: Quick up-down
steps.description: Light up-down on the higher strings.

steps.title: Full loop
steps.description: Loop D X DU X DU at 85 BPM over D G A Bm.

lessons.title: Barre Chords Mastery
lessons.description: Learn and practise barre chord techniques.

steps.title: Barre mechanics
steps.description: Index finger pressure and thumb position behind the neck.

steps.title: E-shape barre
steps.description: Form the F barre chord cleanly.

steps.title: A-shape barre
steps.description: Form the B and Bm barre chords.

steps.title: Strength builder
steps.description: Hold the barre for 20 seconds, rest, repeat.

steps.title: Progression practice
steps.description: Switch between barre and open chords.

steps.title: Thumb independence
steps.description: Play bass notes with the thumb only.

steps.title: Pattern 1
steps.description: Thumb–index–middle–ring sequence.

steps.title: Pattern 2
steps.description: Alternating bass with melody notes.

steps.title: Arpeggio flow
steps.description: Play across 4 strings evenly.

steps.title: Mini etude
steps.description: Play a 2-chord fingerstyle pattern.

lessons.title: Spider Walk – Speed Drill
lessons.description: Play 1-2-3-4 on every string starting from the low E.

steps.title: Spider walk
steps.description: One finger per fret, 1-2-3-4, ascending then descending across all strings.

lessons.title: Scales and Exercises
lessons.description: Practise scales to improve finger dexterity.

steps.title: Major scale shape
steps.description: Play the C major scale across 1 octave.

steps.title: Minor scale shape
steps.description: Play the A minor scale across 1 octave.

steps.title: Alternate picking
steps.description: Down-up picking for scale runs.

steps.title: Speed ladder
steps.description: Increase BPM from 80 to 120.

steps.title: Accuracy test
steps.description: Play 2 minutes without mistakes.

lessons.title: Capo Transposition Quiz
lessons.description: If the base key is G and the capo is on the 2nd fret, what is the new key?

steps.title: Capo maths
steps.description: Each fret raises the pitch by one semitone. G + 2 = A.

songs.title: O Sanam
songs.notes: Community-sourced progression. Verify against the tutorial and adjust the capo to your voice.

songs.title: Yaaron
songs.strummingPattern: D D U U D U

songs.title: Tum Hi Ho
songs.strummingPattern: D D U U D U

songs.title: Pal
songs.strummingPattern: D D U U D U

songs.title: Pee Loon
songs.album: Once Upon a Time in Mumbaai

songs.title: Tere Paas Main
songs.notes: Added from a chord sheet shared by a learner. Title and artist still need confirming, and lyrics are not stored here. A# is the same chord as Bb.

songs.title: Agar Tum Saath Ho
songs.notes: Capo 1, D-family shapes. Sources agree on capo 1 with D/Bm/A/G. Bm can be played as a 4-string mini barre. Play softly; arpeggiate the verse. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Phir Le Aaya Dil (Reprise)
techniqueFocus: C to D walk back to G
songs.notes: Arijit Singh reprise version, no capo, open G/Am/C/D. Other versions differ: Shafqat Amanat Ali's is in A, Rekha Bhardwaj's in C. Duration is the soundtrack reprise (~4:45). Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Iktara
songs.notes: Two sources agree: key G, no capo, G/C/Am/D with a single F in the antara (F can be played as Fmaj7 x33210). Some players note the record may use open-G tuning; standard tuning works fine. BPM approximate. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Hawayein
songs.notes: Sources agree on no capo with D, G, A, Em. Strumming varies between sources (DDU UDU vs D UDUD UDUD DU); the simpler one is used. BPM approximate. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Saiyaara
songs.strummingPattern: D D U U D U
techniqueFocus: smooth chord changes on the beat
songs.notes: Capo 4 with Em-family shapes (sounds G#m); two sources agree on capo 4 and the Em-D-C-D loop. Bm only appears in the pre-chorus; Cmaj7 can replace C for colour. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Tum Se Hi
songs.strummingPattern: D D U U D U
songs.notes: Capo 4 with D shapes is the common version (capo 6 with C shapes also gives the same key). One source lists a no-capo G version, which is a half-step off the record. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Raataan Lambiyan
songs.notes: Capo 1 with A/E/D shapes; an alternative is capo 3 with G/C/D shapes (same sounding key). Strumming differs across sources; DDU DD and D DUD are both common. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Ilahi
songs.notes: Sources agree: key A, no capo, A with Dsus2/D and E. Only three shapes but the tempo is quick (~132 BPM) - practise slowly first. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Kesariya
songs.notes: Key C, no capo, built on Fmaj7-G-C. The full F in the chorus can stay Fmaj7 for beginners. Some sheets offer a capo-2 C/G/Am/F version for singing range. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Tujhe Kitna Chahne Lage
songs.notes: Capo 4 with G shapes (original key B). Multiple sources list G/Em/C/D plus Am/Bm with capo 4. Verse is all open chords; the chorus adds Bm. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Jo Bhi Main
songs.notes: Sources agree: no capo, Em/D/G/Am, with Em7, Dsus4, Dsus2 as optional colours. BPM and duration approximate. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Ishq Bulaava
songs.notes: 6/8 feel (160 BPM eighth-note pulse). Sources agree on key Am, no capo, Am-G core; verse and antara voicings vary (Em/D/Bm vs Em/G/C) - simplest open shapes used. Duration approximate. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Kun Faya Kun
songs.artist: A.R. Rahman, Javed Ali, Mohit Chauhan
songs.notes: Capo 1 with C shapes confirmed by multiple sources. Section order varies between sheets; this follows the most common layout. One sheet adds a Cm at the end of the antara. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Shayad
songs.notes: Capo 1, Em-scale shapes (sounds Fm) - all sources agree. The chorus line order differs between sheets; this uses the most common Em-D-C-D-Bm-C-Em shape. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Apna Bana Le
songs.notes: Two sources agree on capo 2 with G-family shapes (G/C/D/Em/Am/Bm). The sounding key is stated differently across sites (A vs B); A is what capo 2 + G shapes gives. Strumming suggestions vary. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Satranga
songs.notes: Key C, no capo, C/Am/F/G. A popular 'easy' capo-5 version uses G-family shapes (plus F#, B7) - same sounding key. Sheets disagree on bar order; this is the simplest. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Zehnaseeb
songs.notes: Sources agree on key D, no capo, D-G-Am-C hook. Mute strings on the 2nd downstroke for a groove. One sheet adds E and B passing chords; omitted here. Listed 158 BPM elsewhere is double-time. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Khairiyat
techniqueFocus: E major in a minor key
songs.notes: Original key Cm (confirmed by multiple sources); capo 3 with Am/F/G/E/Dm/C shapes avoids the Cm/A#/G# barres. F can be played as a mini barre. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Main Rang Sharbaton Ka
techniqueFocus: F barre high up with capo 7
songs.notes: Sounding key G. Capo 7 with C shapes is common; the same progression without capo is G-Em-C-D. Duration approximate. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Tu Jaane Na
songs.notes: Key A. No-capo A/C#m/Bm/E is used here; easier alternative is capo 2 with G/Bm/Am/D (same key). Other sheets in G or D are off-key. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Dil Diyan Gallan
songs.strummingPattern: D U X U U X U
songs.notes: Key D, no capo (D/Bm/G/A/F#m). Alternative capo-2 C-shape version gives the same key. X = palm-muted chuck. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: O Maahi
songs.notes: Capo 1 with C/G/F/Am/Em shapes (sounds C#) - two sources agree. One sheet lists 177 BPM, which is double-time; ~88 used. Em appears in the second verse. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Chaleya
songs.notes: Key Am, no capo, ~94 BPM - sources agree. The verse uses Amadd9 on the sheet; plain Am works. F7 on the sheet simplified to F. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Zinda
songs.strummingPattern: D D D U D U D D
songs.notes: Key Em, no capo. Sources disagree on the chorus (Em-C-G-D vs Em-G-D-A); Em-C-G-D (played as power chords on the record) is the most common. Duration and BPM approximate. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Kal Ho Naa Ho
songs.notes: Sources agree on key C, no capo, with C/F/G/Am(or Em)/Gm/Gm7/Dm7. The Gm (and later Cm/Fm/D# section) make it advanced; one sheet uses Em where another uses Am in the verse. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Pehla Nasha
songs.notes: Key F, no capo (two sources agree). Barre-heavy: F, A#, Gm, G#. Beginners can use capo 3 with D/G/A/Bm shapes or capo 5 with C/F/G/Am shapes (same key). Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Bekhayali
songs.notes: Key Am, ~90 BPM, no capo - sources agree. Sheet's Am/F written here as F. A capo-5 version exists for easier shapes. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Ae Dil Hai Mushkil
songs.notes: Sounds D#m. Capo 1 with Dm shapes (Dm/A#/Gm/A/C/Am) vs capo 4 with Bm/Em/G/F# - both give D#m and both need barres. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Muskurane
songs.notes: Key Bm, no capo: Bm/A/G/F#/Em. Easier: capo 2 with Am/G/F/E shapes (same key). Strumming suggestions vary widely. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Sadda Haq
songs.strummingPattern: D D D D D D D D
songs.notes: Key F#m with F#m/D/Bm/E (A in places) - sources agree. Played as all palm-muted downstrokes; power chords also work. BPM approximate. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Knockin' on Heaven's Door
songs.strummingPattern: D - D U - U D U
techniqueFocus: G to D to Am changes
songs.notes: Whole song is one 8-bar loop (G D Am / G D C). Every chart agrees. Many players use Am7 or C as Cadd9 for smoother changes. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Bad Moon Rising
techniqueFocus: quick A-to-G change inside one bar
songs.notes: Verse bar 2 splits A and G (two beats each). Chorus: 2 bars G, 2 bars D, 1 A, 1 G, 2 D. Hooktheory and Lauren Bateman agree; tempo about 180 bpm. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Brown Eyed Girl
songs.notes: Recording opens with a lead-guitar riff over G C G D; strumming those chords works. JustinGuitar and Heartwood agree on the C D G Em C D G D chorus. The refrain is often shown with D7. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Stand By Me
songs.strummingPattern: D - D U - U D U
songs.notes: Recording is in A (A F#m D E). The usual guitar version uses capo 2 with G Em C D shapes. Without a capo, play A F#m D E. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Let It Be
songs.strummingPattern: D - D U - U D U
techniqueFocus: small F or Fmaj7 as a stepping stone
songs.notes: Piano-led recording in C with no capo. Some charts write passing F/A or C/G bass walks; the core shapes are always C G Am F. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Take Me Home, Country Roads
songs.notes: Recording is in A. Capo 2 with G-shapes is the standard learner version; the e-chords and UG charts agree. The bridge D is often played as D7. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: I'm Yours
songs.album: We Sing. We Dance. We Steal Things.
songs.strummingPattern: D - D U - U D U
songs.notes: Recording sounds in B. Popular charts use either capo 4 with C G Am F or half-step-down tuning with the same shapes; both sound the same. Some charts write the chorus F as F with a D7 turnaround. Strum with a skank/chop feel; the tempo can be counted as 76 half-time. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Let Her Go
songs.strummingPattern: D D D U D U
songs.notes: Passenger plays capo 7 with G-major shapes, so it sounds in D. Heartwood and National Guitar Academy agree on the sections. Bm is the only barre chord; a Bm7 or a mini Bm works. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Perfect
techniqueFocus: Em7 to Csus2 voicings with anchor fingers
songs.notes: Capo 1 with G shapes, sounding in G#/Ab. Bell & Co and Fender agree. The recording uses Em7/Csus2 voicings; plain Em/C is fine for beginners. 12/8 at about 63 bpm (dotted quarter), often felt as 95. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Riptide
songs.strummingPattern: D D U U D U
songs.notes: Capo 1 with Am G C shapes (sounds C#/Db). Guitaring.net, ozbcoz and Glanworth agree. F (or Fmaj7) appears only in the build/bridge. Chord changes come on beat 4 in some bars, so practise slowly. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Blowin' in the Wind
songs.strummingPattern: D - D U - U D U
songs.notes: Sounds in D. Dylan actually played G-shapes with capo 7 (dylanchords.com); this chart uses the no-capo D shapes from Bell & Co, which sound the same. Em is often skipped in simplified charts. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Stick Season
songs.strummingPattern: D D D U D U
songs.notes: Sounds in A. Lauren Bateman uses capo 2 with G D Em C; ChordsWorld and e-chords show A E F#m D with no capo, which is the same. Lauren's chorus adds a passing E shape near the end; the loop above is the common version. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Wonderwall
techniqueFocus: anchor fingers on B and e strings
songs.notes: Capo 2 standard. UG and GuitarPlayerBox agree. Ring fingers 3 and 4 stay on frets 3 of B and e for every shape. Dsus4 is often written Dsus4/F#. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Photograph
songs.strummingPattern: D - D U - U D U
techniqueFocus: Bm barre in a pop loop
dynamic build from picked verse to strummed chorus
songs.notes: Sounds in E. Sources split between capo 2 (D Bm A G) and capo 4 (C Am G F); both sound in E. We use the capo 2 version. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Someone Like You
songs.notes: Piano original in A. Capo 2 with G-shapes is standard (UG, GuitarPlayerBox, guitardownunder). Arpeggiate eighth notes to copy the piano; Bm/F# can be simplified to Bm. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Yellow
songs.strummingPattern: D - D U - U D U
techniqueFocus: ringing open strings over moving bass
songs.notes: Recording in B (B, F#6, Emaj7). Most learner charts use capo 4 with G D C(maj7) shapes. Chris Martin's own voicings keep the top strings ringing (sus/add shapes). Bar lengths in the verse vary a little between charts. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Viva La Vida
songs.album: Viva la Vida or Death and All His Friends
songs.notes: Capo 1 with C D G Em shapes, sounding in G#/Ab (Db Eb Ab Fm). UG and GuitarTabsExplorer agree. Bm (the last chorus line) is the only barre chord. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Shape of You
songs.strummingPattern: D - D U - U D U
songs.notes: One loop the whole way: C#m F#m A B in C#m. JustinGuitar and GuitarPlayerBox both use capo 4 with Am Dm F G. Rhythm matters more than chords; mute on beats 2 and 4. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Counting Stars
songs.notes: Sounds C#m E B A. Capo 4 with Am C G F (Bell & Co, guitaretab). Same loop all song; the challenge is keeping the 16th strum going at full speed. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Wake Me Up
songs.notes: Bm (i-VI-III-VII) at 124 bpm, per Hooktheory and UG. Some charts use capo 2 Am F C G (same sound). Hooktheory notes the verse leaves out the A on some passes; holding D is fine. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Stay With Me
songs.notes: Sounds in C (Am F C loop). e-chords uses no capo with Am F C; Bell & Co uses capo 5 with Em C G, which is the same. Chorus bar 5 is sometimes G7 or G/B. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Hallelujah
songs.notes: Cohen's recording is in C (JustinGuitar, National Guitar Academy). Jeff Buckley's cover is also often played in C. Count in 6/8 or 12/8; some charts write E instead of E7. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Wish You Were Here
songs.strummingPattern: D - D U - U D U
techniqueFocus: D/F# with thumb or bass note
songs.notes: Standard tuning, no capo. JustinGuitar, Lauren Bateman and UG agree. The intro has a single-note lead riff; strumming the chord loop is enough to play along. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Hey There Delilah
songs.strummingPattern: D - D U - U D U
songs.notes: Key D at 104 bpm (Tunebat, Musicnotes). UG and Chordify charts use D F#m Bm G A with no capo. The recording is fingerpicked; strumming works for beginners. The pre-chorus A-G-A turnaround is left out here. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Hotel California
songs.strummingPattern: D - D U - U D U
songs.notes: Played in Bm with barre chords (National Guitar Academy, Lauren Bateman). Don Felder's 12-string uses capo 7 with Am E G D F C Dm E shapes, which sound the same. The single was released in 1977; the album came out in December 1976. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Sweet Child O' Mine
songs.strummingPattern: D - D U - U D U
songs.notes: Guitars are tuned down a half step (Eb standard), so D shapes sound C#/Db; capo stays 0. Played in standard tuning, the shapes sound a half step higher than the record. GuitarTabsExplorer and Songsterr agree on the chords. The famous intro is a single-note riff over these chords. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Creep
songs.strummingPattern: D - D U - U D U
techniqueFocus: dynamic muted verse to loud chorus
songs.notes: G B C Cm loop the whole song, G major at 92 bpm (songbpm, Chordify). The B and Cm barres are the challenge. Single 1992, album 1993. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: More Than Words
songs.strummingPattern: D - X - D U X U
songs.notes: Nuno Bettencourt tunes down a half step, so G shapes sound F#; capo 0. Some charts use standard tuning (sounds in G) or capo shapes. Tempo is about 90-95 bpm; sources vary. Many voicings and fast changes. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Tears in Heaven
songs.strummingPattern: D - D U - U D U
songs.notes: Main sections in A; the bridge moves to G before returning (Jon MacLennan, UG). F#m is often F#m7. Slash chords define the bass line; detection may hear A/E as A. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: The House of the Rising Sun
songs.notes: Am C D F / Am C E E / Am C D F / Am E Am E (Applied Guitar Theory, UG). 6/8; tempo is quoted as 117-125. Rated advanced for the full-barre F and a steady 6/8 arpeggio; the chords alone are intermediate. The outro chord before the end is sometimes Dm. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Dil Mere
songs.notes: Guitartwitt: capo 1, key Ab(G#), G-D-Em-C shapes; Gitagram tab also lists key Ab. Signature intro is a picked riff (tab-only) - chords here are the rhythm part. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Sar Kiye Pahar
songs.notes: Indichords and other sources (UG, guitarchordsgaga) agree on G-C-F-C-G chorus and Am-F-C-G verse, key G. F can be simplified to Fmaj7 for beginners. BPM/duration not verified. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Aadat
songs.notes: Chordsfactory: capo 4, Am-F-G shapes (sounding C#m). Gitagram lists capo 2 with the same shapes (sounding Bm) - most sources and the original recording key cited as C#m, so capo 4 used. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Woh Lamhe
songs.notes: Jal original detected as G#m-F#-E (no capo); Chordsfactory gives capo 4 Em-D-C shapes = same sounding chords. The later Jubin Nautiyal remake is in a different key - not this one. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Dil Haarey
songs.notes: Gitagram and Guitar-Gaga both give key G, G-C based. Guitar-Gaga's chorus adds D and Bm (G D C G C D Bm D C); Gitagram's simpler G-C version used here. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Kandisa
songs.notes: Both sources agree on key D with a D-A core. Bridge colour chords disagree (blog: E; Chordify: G and Bm), so only the agreed D-A sections are included. Lyrics are an Aramaic chant - language code 'arc' (Aramaic); app may expect hi. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Dooba Dooba
songs.notes: G-C-D shapes agree across Gitagram, Musiceducademy and GuitarTabsExplorer, but the SOUNDING key disagrees (G no capo / Ab capo 3 / F# capo 1). Shapes reliable; capo/key unverified. Thinly sourced chart – check it against the recording.

songs.title: Dhaani
songs.notes: Tabandchord: A-G-D throughout, key A. GuitarTabsExplorer uses the same A-Em-G-D set but calls it D and gives a Bm-G-D-A bridge. Sounding tonic is A (A mixolydian); bridge chords differ between sources. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Good Riddance (Time of Your Life)
songs.notes: Standard tuning, no capo, key G - all major chord sites agree. Original is picked/strummed hybrid; the strum here is a simplification. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Demons
songs.notes: Sounding Eb(D#) major; capo 3 with C-G-Am-F shapes is the near-universal guitar version. Bridge order is an approximation of the same four-chord loop. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Choo Lo
songs.notes: Guitartwitt: capo 2, D-A-Bm-G, key E. Other sources use capo 4 with C-G-Am-F shapes - same sounding key E, so they agree. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Aaftaab
songs.notes: Gitagram: capo 6, C-shapes = F#; Chordify detection lists C#, B, F#, D#m (consistent). GuitarTabsExplorer shows the same progression in G with no capo (a semitone high). Chorus voicing differs between sources. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Maaeri
songs.notes: Wrytin: capo 1, Dsus2-A-G-C verse (Dsus2 written as D), chorus Dsus2-Cadd9-Bb-C. Chordify gives the original as Eb(D#) major (D#, C#, G#, A#) which matches capo 1 D-C-G-A shapes; the A#-shape in the chorus is not in Chordify's list - doubt. Album attribution unverified. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Duur
songs.notes: Musiccircle and Bajao Guitars give key F (F-Bb-C-Gm-Dm); shapes here are those chords with capo 3. Wrytin uses the same D-shape progression but with capo 2 (sounding E) - key disagreement noted. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Najane Kyun
songs.notes: Guitaretab gives full structure in G; Chordify/search summaries agree on key G with G-D-C-Em-Bm-Am. Some versions add Gadd9/Dsus4 embellishments. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Yaar Bina
songs.notes: GreatGuitarChords and ChordU both put it in A minor with Am-C-G-F-Dm. Intro is an Am riff (tab) rather than strummed chords. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Jazba-e-Junoon
songs.strummingPattern: D D U D U D D U
songs.notes: IndianGuitarTabs thread gives Am-G-F-C-E in A minor; UG summary agrees on Am-G-F-C. Section split is approximate and the original-recording key was not independently confirmed. Thinly sourced chart – check it against the recording.

songs.title: Saari Raat Jaga
songs.notes: Guitaretab: no capo, key C#m (C#m-A-E-B-G#m-F#m); another chart uses capo 4 with Am-F-C-G - identical sounding chords. Capo 4 shapes used. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Aro Ekbar
songs.notes: GuitarTabsExplorer: Em-G-A-D-C (no capo stated); GenuineChords: F#m-A-B-E-D, i.e. the same shapes a whole step up. Capo 2 reconciles both at F#m. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Take It Easy
songs.notes: Key G, standard tuning - GuitarTabsExplorer and UG agree on G-D-C-Em-Am. Original intro uses a Gsus/Csus voicing; simplified to G. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Boulevard of Broken Dreams
songs.strummingPattern: D D U D U D U
songs.notes: Sounding F minor; capo 1 with Em-G-D-A shapes is the standard version (others play Fm-Ab-Eb-Bb barre). Post-chorus ends on B7 (sounding C7). Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Hey Jude
songs.notes: Original in F (F-C-C7-Bb-Eb). Capo 3 with D-A-G-C shapes avoids barre chords; C shape in the coda sounds Eb. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Fix You
songs.notes: Sounding Eb(D#) major; capo 3 with C-Em-Am-G-F is the standard guitar version. Original is organ/piano-led. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: In the End
songs.notes: Original is piano in Ebm (D#m-B-F#-C#). Capo 6 Am-F-C-G reproduces it; many tabs instead play Em-C-G-D tuned a half step down. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Sayonee
songs.notes: IndianGuitarTabs and Acousterr both put it in D minor (Acousterr simplifies to Dm-F-C). Chordify detection adds Gm, A7 and A#maj7. Sequence approximate; key consistent. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Bandeh
songs.notes: Several sources agree on C minor with Cm, Ab(G#), Bb(A#). Exact section order is approximate. Easier: capo 3 with Am-F-G shapes. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Fish Rock
songs.notes: Myoozic: Dm-Am-Gm-C, key Dm; ChordU detection agrees on Dm/Am/Gm but lists F instead of C. Lead part uses DADABE tuning. Thin sourcing - treat as approximate. Thinly sourced chart – check it against the recording.

songs.title: Firefly
songs.strummingPattern: D D D D D D
songs.notes: ChordZone and Khmerchords agree: key B, no capo, 6/8 at ~120. Original barre shapes kept for the advanced tier; easier version is capo 4 with G-Am-C-D-Em shapes. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Aahatein
songs.notes: Musiceducademy and other charts agree: key D, D-Bm-Em-F#m loop, no capo. Outro (C-G-A) omitted. Community chart – sources differ in places; trust your ears.

songs.title: Here Comes the Sun
songs.notes: Sounding A major; capo 7 with D-G-A7 shapes as George Harrison played it. Bridge has shifting meters - bar count simplified. Chart cross-checked against several sources.

songs.title: Chanakya
songs.notes: Starts slow with a free, alaap-like sitar intro over a D drone. Then a short, repeating minor-key hook comes in over the groove. It builds with longer runs and call-and-response between the sitar and the rhythm, and ends with fast, tightly picked phrases on the higher strings. The tab here is a warm-up in the piece's scale (D, E, F, G, A, A#, C), written for SurSaar – not the composition. Paste a tab of the melody to learn it note by note.

songs.title: The Burning Ghat
songs.notes: A slow, meditative tribute to the eternal pyre at Manikarnika Ghat in Varanasi. Sitar carries the melody over an ambient bed of electronic synths and piano, with tabla and percussion. It moves from a contemplative opening to a fuller, rhythmic middle and returns to calm near the end. Runs about 7 minutes. Key and tempo aren't published yet, so there is no tab – paste one to learn it note by note.

songs.title: Shiv Kailash (Shiv Kailashon Ke Vasi)
techniqueFocus: simple major-key melody on one string
playing along with a three-chord strum
songs.notes: A folk-bhajan melody for Shiva, played on sitar with the crowd singing along. A short, simple tune repeats with more ornaments each time. It starts gently and builds into a rousing, clap-along rhythm by the end. The tab here is a warm-up in the piece's scale (D, E, F#, G, A, B, C#), written for SurSaar – not the composition. Paste a tab of the melody to learn it note by note.

songs.title: Tandavam
songs.notes: A high-energy Shiva piece that mixes sitar, a chanted Shiva stotram and electronic drums. Sitar hooks alternate with chanted sections and grow into a powerful, dance-like climax. The tab here is a warm-up in the piece's scale (D, E, F#, G, A, B, C#), written for SurSaar – not the composition. Paste a tab of the melody to learn it note by note.

songs.title: Doordarshan Signature Tune
songs.artist: Pt. Ravi Shankar & Ustad Ali Ahmed Hussain Khan
techniqueFocus: short melodic phrase on one string
songs.notes: A short sitar-and-shehnai theme, about half a minute, that played as Doordarshan's on-air logo animated. Ravi Shankar built it as a variation on his tune for 'Saare Jahan Se Achha'. One flowing phrase rises and settles back home. Key and tempo aren't published yet, so there is no tab – paste one to learn it note by note.

songs.title: Jana Gana Mana
techniqueFocus: small range (lower Ni to upper Sa)
songs.notes: Public domain (Words and music by Rabindranath Tagore (died 1941); Indian copyright expired at the end of 2001 (60 years after death).) Melody converted from sargam with Sa = C; note lengths are approximate. One stanza (the official 52-second version): long repeated-note phrases on Ga, a climb to Pa for the Punjab-Sindh line, phrases that keep resolving to Sa, and the rising 'Jaya he' ending that finishes on Ma. Please practise the national anthem respectfully.

songs.title: Raghupati Raghav Raja Ram (Ram Dhun)
songs.artist: Traditional (popularised by V. D. Paluskar / Gandhi)
techniqueFocus: lower-octave notes (Pa, Dha, Ni below Sa)
songs.notes: Public domain (Text traditionally attributed to Lakshmanacharya (17th c.); the well-known tune is linked to Vishnu Digambar Paluskar (died 1931), so any copyright ended long ago.) Melody converted from sargam with Sa = C; note lengths are approximate. Call-and-response Ram dhun. A refrain starts on lower Pa and settles on Sa, an answering line dips into komal Ga and komal Ni, and a middle line ('Ishwar Allah tero naam') rises to Ma and returns to the refrain.

songs.title: Vaishnav Jan To Tene Kahiye
songs.notes: Public domain (Text by Narsinh Mehta (15th c.); sung to a traditional tune in Mishra Khamaj; no living author.) Melody converted from sargam with Sa = C; note lengths are approximate. Every verse uses the same four-line tune. Line 1 sits around Ga and Ma, lines 2 and 4 climb through Pa and Dha to upper Sa and come back down through komal Ni, and line 3 hovers on Dha and komal Ni before the cadence back to Sa.

songs.title: Om Jai Jagdish Hare
songs.notes: Public domain (Written by Shardha Ram Phillauri (died 1881); the aarti tune is traditional. The 1970 film version (Purab Aur Paschim) is a separate copyrighted recording.) Melody converted from sargam with Sa = C; note lengths are approximate. Refrain plus verses that share one tune. The refrain sits on Sa and rises to Pa and Dha on 'Swami jai Jagdish hare'. The middle lines wave around Re, Ga and Ma, and each verse ends by falling to lower Ni and Dha before the refrain comes back.

songs.title: Jai Ganesh Jai Ganesh Deva
techniqueFocus: tivra Ma vs shuddha Ma (F# vs F)
songs.notes: Public domain (Traditional aarti, text attributed to Surdas (16th c.); traditional tune. Commercial recordings (e.g. Anuradha Paudwal, T-Series) are copyrighted, but the tune itself is not.) Melody converted from sargam with Sa = C; note lengths are approximate. The refrain 'Jai Ganesh' climbs Sa-Re-Ga and repeats Ga. The 'Mata jaki Parvati' line dips to lower Ni and resolves to Sa. The antara ('Ek dant dayavant') jumps up to Pa and swings between Pa and tivra Ma before coming down to Ga.
